zh.name: GG
zh.role: 数据分析师 / 业务洞察探索者
zh.tagline: 我把复杂数据整理成清晰判断，也把职业成长写成可以被看见的证据。
zh.intro: 这个页面是简历之外的补充：你可以快速了解我的成长背景、分析方法、项目成果，以及我如何把数据问题转化为业务行动。
zh.heroNote: 观察 / 解释 / 行动
zh.story: 我进入数据分析，是从持续追问“为什么这个结果会发生”开始的。相比只交付报表，我更在意问题被重新定义、指标被正确解释、结论能被团队采用。过去的学习和项目让我逐渐形成一套习惯：先理解业务场景，再拆解数据口径，最后用清晰表达推动决策。
zh.storyAside: 从业务问题开始，沿着证据走到行动。
zh.projectsIntro: 把分析过程讲清楚，比罗列工具更重要。
zh.skillsIntro: 从定义问题到表达结论，我把工具放在流程里使用。
zh.contactLead: 如果你也在寻找让数据变得有用的方式，欢迎联系我。
zh.aiTitle: 和我的 AI 助手聊聊
zh.aiIntro: 你可以问它关于我的成长背景、项目经历、技能工具或求职方向的问题。
zh.interestsIntro: 工作之外，我用一些长期兴趣保持身体、创造力和好奇心的连接。

en.name: Your Name
en.tagline: I turn complex data into clear judgment, and make my growth visible beyond a traditional resume.
en.intro: This page complements my resume with context: my growth story, analytical habits, selected projects, and how I translate data questions into business action.
en.story: My path into data analytics started with a habit of asking why a result happened. I care about more than producing dashboards: I want to define the right problem, clarify metrics, and communicate findings that a team can actually use. Through learning and project work, I have built a practical workflow: understand the business context, validate the data, then turn analysis into decisions.
en.storyAside: Start with the business question. Follow the evidence to action.
en.projectsIntro: The reasoning matters more than a list of tools.
en.skillsIntro: I use tools inside a workflow, from framing to communication.
en.contactLead: If you are looking for ways to make data useful, I would love to hear from you.
en.aiIntro: Ask about my growth story, projects, skills, or career direction.
en.interestsIntro: Outside work, a few long-term interests keep me connected to movement, creativity, and curiosity.
